purpose: Pre-register the configuration, hypotheses and decision rules for the RL run that follows the review fixes, so the result cannot be reinterpreted after the fact.

configuration.reward: v3 (REWARD_V3=1) -- functional pipette task, exploit-free success, measured grasp geometry
configuration.action_basis: ACTION_BASIS=1 -- critic sees 180 DCT coefficients, not 900 raw scalars
configuration.critic_state: CRITIC_STATE=1 -- proprioception, object and plunger state, phase one-hot
configuration.demo_buffer: MUST be rebuilt under v3 with recorded critic state; the trainer refuses a mismatch

what_changed_since_the_last_run: gamma: terminal credit 0.001 -> 0.63 (the previous run was effectively myopic)
critic action input: 900 -> 180 dims (8.2 -> 41 transitions per input dimension)
critic conditioning: RGB only -> RGB + proprioception + object/plunger state + phase
reward: transport-only, with a success predicate a mid-air throw satisfied -> functional pipette task
reward plateau: v1 paid ~3.0 for an off-object hand near the axis; v3 pays ~0

hypotheses.H1_plateau_removal: Removing v1's ~3.0 flat plateau for an off-object hand gives the policy a gradient it previously lacked, so v3 'grasp' rate should RISE above the 3.2% of steps measured on the warm-start checkpoint.
hypotheses.H2_dispense_is_discovery_not_imitation: No executable demonstration dispenses (pending confirmation from the buffer probe), so any press/dispense the policy achieves is discovered from reward, not imitated. Prior expectation is therefore LOW: dispense may well stay at 0.00 within a wall-clock-bounded run.
hypotheses.H3_smoothness: SMOOTH_LAMBDA=100 reproduces the previously validated result: the CAPS penalty roughly halves the oscillation at no task cost.

decision_rules.primary_readout: v3 stage rates on the frozen 25-condition suite: reach, grasp, lift, tube, press, dispense, plate, success. Reported for the warm-start checkpoint AND the retrained checkpoint under the SAME v3 predicate.
decision_rules.success_criterion: A run counts as progress if v3 grasp or lift rises beyond the 8-run noise floor established for this setup. Post-grasp metrics are NOT resolvable from a single evaluation (documented: carry spans 0.00-0.36 across identical repeats), so any single-run post-grasp claim must be reported with that caveat.
decision_rules.failure_is_reportable: If dispense stays 0.00, that is the honest result and will be reported as such: it would show the functional act is not reachable from this initialisation within the compute budget, which is a finding about the task and the data, not a bug to hide.
decision_rules.no_reward_tuning_after_seeing_results: v3's thresholds are fixed by measurement (see g1_piston_reward_v3_review_fixes.json). They will not be adjusted to make the numbers look better; any future change must be justified by a new measurement and recorded.

known_limitations_carried_in: The actor remains a diagonal-covariance Gaussian over 900 scalars; real chunks live on a ~16-dim manifold. A structured or diffusion policy is the recommended next architecture and is NOT tested here.
The grasp predicate is a geometric proxy: this scene ships no contact sensors.
Only 22 of 67 dataset episodes are executable under this embodiment, and the SFT initialisation scores 0.00 deterministic success.
